title: MSE's Strachan named APS fellow for research on materials under extreme conditions
summary_en: Alejandro (Ale) Strachan, Reilly Professor of Materials Engineering in Purdue University's School of Materials Engineering, has been named a 2026 Fellow of the American Physical Society (APS) through the Topical Group on Compression of Condensed Matter.
